completionText.english: Pia asked me to get a gift for her friend who decided to set out on an adventure, and I brought it back for her. But it seems this alone isn’t enough.
completionText.chinese: 给射手村公园的皮亚为做拳套需要的所有材料后，从她那儿收到了飞侠专用衣服。她说这是她为我特意做的。我一定要好好穿这件衣服。不过她的朋友出发了没有呢？说不定会在途中遇到呢。

summary.english: Pio in Amherst wants you to help collect recycled goods.
summary.chinese: 彩虹村的皮奥有拜托。。。

description.english: You ran into Pio, who is famous in Amherst for fixing broken goods. He asks you to break down scrap boxes from around town and bring back Rusty Screws and Old Wooden Boards.

completionText.english: You broke the boxes and collected supplies for Pio. It was fun because you found other useful items in the boxes as well.
completionText.chinese: 受皮奥所托，我收集了几个还可以用的垃圾后给了他。

summary.english: Let's go to Pia in Henesys.
summary.chinese: 要去射手公园的皮亚

description.english: Pia also asked me to retrieve the Red Cape that Rina in Henesys borrowed for her friend. I’ll probably get something nice if I bring it back to her.
description.chinese: 在射手村的公园里又见到了皮亚，她还穿着那件奇怪的衣服。她说这次她的朋友决定去冒险，所以她想为朋友准备拳套！但是为了做拳套需要#b15个银，50个龙皮，40个螺丝钉#k。。。 尤其她拜托我找回射手村的丽娜借去的#b红色披风#k。要是我拿给她这些东西，她肯定会好好报答。

completionText.english: I went to Rina to get Pia's cape, but Rina told me that she's keeping the cape until Pia brings back what she borrowed from her. She said she will return the cape if she gets back what Pia has borrowed.
completionText.chinese: 为了找回披风要见丽娜

summary.english: It seems Rina has her own reasons for not returning what she borrowed from Pia.
summary.chinese: 看来丽娜不归还从皮亚那里借来的东西，是有自己的原因。

description.english: I went to see Rina in Henesys, and instead, she tells me she took that red cape because Pia didn't return the items she borrowed from her. She said that she would return the cape if she gets her items back... the items are 1 Black Crystal, 1 Ancient Scroll, and 30 Medicine With Weird Vibes.
description.chinese:
射手村的丽娜说那披风原来是因为皮亚没还给她借去的物品所以，她才保留了披风。如果我替皮亚还给她皮亚借过去的物品，她就给我披风...皮亚借去的物品是#b1个黑水晶，1个古代的卷轴，30个月牙牛魔王的角#k…

completionText.english: I paid off Pia's debt to Rina on her behalf and received the Red Cape in return. Now I just need to bring this back to Pia, right
completionText.chinese: 我要找回披风去丽娜了，但她却说原来皮亚借她的物品去后还没还给她了。这么说她让我替皮亚还给那些东西。。。

summary.english: It looks like Rina is ready to return the Red Cape she borrowed from Pia.
summary.chinese: 看来丽娜已经准备好归还从皮亚那里借来的红披风了。

description.english: I got my hands on the Red Cape that Pia asked for. Now I just need to bring it back to her.
description.chinese: 我拿到了皮亚要的红披风。现在只需要把它带回给她。

completionText.english: I delivered the materials needed to make the claw to Pia in Henesys Park and received the scroll. I wonder if Pia’s friend has already set out on their adventure by now. Who knows—maybe I’ll even run into them during my travels!
completionText.chinese: 我把制作拳套所需的材料交给了射手村公园的皮亚，并收到了卷轴。不知道皮亚的朋友现在是不是已经踏上冒险旅程了。谁知道呢——也许我旅行途中还会遇见他们！

quests.english: The Reason Behind the Mushroom Studies

summary.english: I should go see Bruce in Henesys...
summary.chinese: 去找射手村的布鲁斯好了…

description.english: I got to meet Bruce, who has been studying monsters and animals in Henesys. His bright smile and the easygoing demeanor belies the painful fact that his daughter has been missing for some time, and that he's been studying the mushroom monsters for the sake of finding clues of his daughter's whereabouts. He asks me if I can help him out, and I just can't say no to a worthy cause like this...
description.chinese:
在射手村见到了研究怪物与动物的学者—布鲁斯，虽然他总是面带微笑，但过去有过惨痛经历的他，为了获得女儿的消息，正针对蘑菇怪物进行研究。他希望我帮他收集研究用的材料…  

#t4000011# #b#c4000011##k/10 
#t4000001# #b#c4000001##k/40

completionText.english: I helped Bruce gather up the materials necessary for his studies. Will these help him find his daughter
completionText.chinese: 我帮布鲁斯收集了所需要的研究材料，希望他可以找到失散的女儿…

quests.english: I Need to Find My Daughter 1

summary.english: I wonder how Bruce is doing in Henesys these days...
summary.chinese: 去见见射手村的布鲁斯好了。

description.english: I met up with Bruce in Henesys, and he had great news: He finally found his daughter!!! There was one problem, however... She seems to be suffering from amnesia. Bruce gave me a toy that his daughter played with while growing up, and asked me to give it to her.
description.chinese: 在射手村见到了布鲁斯，在他那里听到了一个好消息。他好像找到了自己的女儿，可是她似乎丧失了之前的记忆，因此要我为她寻找小时候的玩具。

completionText.english: I found Ayan and gave her Ayan's Toy Sword.
completionText.chinese: 将玩具刀交给了伊安。

quests.english: I Need to Find My Daughter 2

summary.english: It seems that Ayan, having regained her memories of the past, is eager to share the news with her father.
summary.chinese: 恢复过去记忆的伊安似乎急着把这个消息告诉父亲。

description.english: Amazingly, Ayan recovered from her amnesia with the help of Ayan's Toy Sword. That's just amazing! The only thing left now is for Ayan and Bruce to finally meet again. But first, I have to get this letter from Ayan to Bruce.
description.chinese: 伊安恢复记忆了！真是太好了~ 现在只剩下让布鲁斯和伊安父女相认了，首先要把伊安的信转交给布鲁斯。

completionText.english: I'm so glad that Ayan got her memory back. I'm even gladder that Bruce got to finally see his daughter again! What a moment...
completionText.chinese: 布鲁斯的女儿终于恢复记忆了，而布鲁斯与伊安也能父女重逢~ 真是太好了！

summary.english: You're not a beginner anymore. Talk to Rain in Amherst and take the Maple Quiz!
summary.chinese: 我已经不是新手了! 我要去找瑞恩,回答她提出的问题!

description.english: You're not a beginner anymore. Talk to Rain and take the Maple Quiz!
description.chinese: 我不是新手了! 我要去尝试回答瑞恩提出的问题!

completionText.english: Rain's first question was about how to hang from a ladder or rope. Alright! up arrow key, make sure to remember it well.
completionText.chinese: 瑞恩的第一个问题是打开背包的快捷键是什么. 是I键

summary.english: Solve Rain's second question.
summary.chinese: 我要回答瑞恩的第二个问题

description.english: What's Rain's second question
description.chinese: 瑞恩提出的第二个问题是什么？

completionText.english: Rain's question was about equippable items, which can be worn by double-clicking on them.
completionText.chinese: 我知道双击背包里的道具就可以穿到身上。

summary.english: Rain's third question.
summary.chinese: 我要回答瑞恩的第三个问题

description.english: Time for Rain's thirds question.
description.chinese: 瑞恩提出的第三个问题是什么？我会容易回答。

completionText.english: In the Equipment Window, I can check the items I'm wearing, and I can also double-click to unequip them.
completionText.chinese: 打开装备窗的快捷键是E!

summary.english: Time to answer Rain's fourth question.
summary.chinese: 该回答瑞恩的第四个问题了。

description.english: You can answer Rain's questions if you think carefully.
description.chinese: 瑞恩提出的问题都不是很难的。

completionText.english: Rain's fourth quiz was about ways to recover HP. I didn't know there were so many different methods! When I find a chair or bench, make sure to sit down.
completionText.chinese: 瑞恩提出的第四个问题是问要拣取道具用什么键。是Z键和右下的数字0键。

summary.english: Rain's fifth question. Wonder what it's about.
summary.chinese: 瑞恩的第五个问题。不知道会问什么。

description.english: What's the fifth question
description.chinese: 第五个问题到底是什么？

completionText.english: Rain asked about job advancements. Warriors, Thieves, Bowmen, and Magicians all need to be at least level 10 to advance.
completionText.chinese: 第五个问题是有关一转的。战士，弓箭手，飞侠在10级可以做一转。但魔法师在8级可以做。

summary.english: Time to answer Rain's question.
summary.chinese: 该回答瑞恩的问题了。

description.english: Finally, the sixth question.
description.chinese: 第六个问题了。现在我对冒险岛知识也了解不少了。

completionText.english: I learned that when I level up, I get AP. If I use the AP on the stats I want, I can increase them, so I’ll make sure to remember that.
completionText.chinese: 我了解了每次升级时我得到1点能力点。我要打开能力窗(S)确认下。

summary.english: This is Rain's last question. Excited
summary.chinese: 这是瑞恩的最后一个问题。有点期待。

description.english: Finally the last question. After this, you'll no longer be a beginner.
description.chinese: 终于是最后的问题。

completionText.english: Rain advised that it's time to leave Maple Island. In Victoria Island, you can choose a job and start a lot of new adventures. Head to Southperryto get to Victoria Island!
completionText.chinese: 她劝我去更广阔的地方。我要去金银岛的话，先要去南港。

summary.english: Arwen the Fairy from Ellinia has lost something...
summary.chinese: 听说魔法密林的艾温丢了什么。。。

description.english: Arwen the Fairy from Ellinia says she lost Arwen's Glass Shoes a couple of days ago, on her way to Perion. A monster covered in flame stole it! Fairies obsess over glimmering, shiny objects so she obviously wants it back... Time to hunt some monsters near Perion.
description.chinese: 魔法密林叫艾温的妖精告诉我，她几天前去勇士部落的路上受到了全身都是火焰的怪物的攻击。那怪物抢走了她贵重的#b玻璃鞋#k。妖精族非常喜欢那样闪闪发光的东西，所以她很想找回来。在勇士部落打怪物的话，说不定可以找回艾温的玻璃鞋。

completionText.english: I returned Arwen's Glass Shoes to Arwen the Fairy in Ellinia. I got lucky, finding it off a nasty Fire Boar. As a sign of gratitude, she gave me a fairy item. It's gorgeous and glimmers like a star. Dang, maybe I can use this to make something special.
completionText.chinese: 我找到那贵重的玻璃鞋后还给了魔法密林的艾温。从很凶猛的火野猪那里抢来了这双玻璃鞋，我是很幸运的啊！艾温表示感谢，给我妖精族的物品。非常漂亮而且闪闪发光的东西！用这个物品也许能做很特别的物品吧？

summary.english: I think Rowen the Fairy in Ellinia has something to ask me...
summary.chinese: 我觉得魔法密林的妖精罗雯好像有事想拜托我……

description.english: I ran into Rowen the Fairy again, who gave me Fresh Milk for Ronnie, Mr. Wetbottom's son. Back then, she seemed to be keeping her guard up against humans, but now, it looks like she accepts me as Ronnie's friend... Rowen the Fairy is assistant to the head magician of Ellinia, Grendel the Really Old, and she tells me that he is concerned about the Cursed Dolls that he made with his black magic a long, long time ago. The dolls had been sealed up for a while, until a bunch of Lupins took them and ran away. The Lupins have since become zombies and have been destroying the forest. To return the forest to how it was before, someone needs to take down the Zombie Lupins and take the Cursed Dolls away from them... So, I readily accepted the request to collect 50 cursed dolls, but I fear those crazy monkeys may be too much to handle...
description.chinese: 我又遇见了妖精罗雯，她曾经把新鲜牛奶交给我，让我带给湿底先生的儿子罗尼。那时候，她似乎对人类很戒备，但现在，她好像已经把我当成罗尼的朋友了……妖精罗雯是魔法密林大魔法师汉斯的助手。她告诉我，汉斯一直很担心那些很久以前由他的黑魔法制造出来的诅咒娃娃。那些娃娃原本被封印了很长一段时间，直到一群猴子把它们偷走并逃跑。后来，那些猴子变成了僵尸猴，并一直在破坏森林。为了让森林恢复原状，必须有人打倒僵尸猴，并从它们身上取回诅咒娃娃……于是，我爽快地接下了收集50个诅咒娃娃的请求，但我担心那些疯狂的猴子可能不好对付……

completionText.english: I eliminated a bunch of Zombie Lupins in a forest near Ellinia and collected all 50 Cursed Dolls for Rowen. In return, she gave me 7 ores. I hope the forest will return to normal...
completionText.chinese: 我在魔法密林附近的森林里消灭了一大群僵尸猴，并为罗雯收集齐了50个诅咒娃娃。作为回报，她给了我7块矿石。希望森林能够恢复正常……

summary.chinese: 继续进行任务：收集70个诅咒娃娃。

summary.chinese: 魔法密林的罗雯需要帮助。。。

description.chinese: 又见到了以前给我新鲜牛奶的#b罗雯#k。那时候她很不喜欢人类，但是现在好像把我当成洛尼的朋友。原来罗雯是魔法密林的大魔法师汉斯的助手。但见面的时候她很担心，因为很久以前汉斯研究过黑魔法，那时候他所诅咒的娃娃现在又出来了。树林里的猴子偷走那娃娃后变成了僵尸猴把树林搞得乱七八糟。为了把树林恢复到原来的样子，必须打退僵尸猴抢回那被#b诅咒的娃娃#k。我这次也答应了收集#b100个诅咒娃娃#k，但是这么凶的对待猴子好不好呢？\n\n#t4000031# #b#c4000031##k/100

completionText.chinese: 在魔法密林附近的树林打退僵尸猴收集了#b100个诅咒娃娃#k。然后收到7个母矿。但那么大的树林是这么容易恢复得吗？

quests.english: First Material for Building a New House

summary.english: Let's go meet Ronnie in the woods in Ellinia.
summary.chinese: 去魔法密林附近的树林见洛尼拔。

description.english: Ronnie from the forest of Ellinia asked me a favor of gathering up materials to build a house for the newborn fairies that are to come down the road. By hunting Horny Mushrooms and Curse Eyes, I’ll need to collect 30 Horny Mushroom Caps and 30 Curse Eye Tails... I guess I can get most of these from the monsters scattered around Ellinia...
description.chinese:
魔法密林的洛尼拜托我收集为妖精族孩子盖新房子所需的材料。需要#b花蘑菇的盖、叶子、软软的液体、红蜗牛的壳各50个#k...可能从草原上的怪物可以得到吧？

completionText.chinese: 我都收集完后给洛尼。不过什么时候给我报酬呢？什么？还有好几次？天啊~

quests.english: Second Material for Building a New House

summary.english: Meet Ronnie in the Unknown Map(105010000).
summary.chinese: 去未知地图(105010000)见罗尼。

description.chinese:
洛尼说这次需要#b三眼章鱼的足、风独眼兽之尾、野猪的尖牙、道符各50个#k。从幽深的树林、高原、蚂蚁洞的怪物那里可以得到吧。都没问题~

completionText.english: I got everything for Ronnie. Please don't tell me he wanted all these for free...!
completionText.chinese: 我收集完后给洛尼了。难道这次的任务是免费的？

quests.english: Third Material for Building a New House

summary.english: Meet Ronnie in the Unknown Map(105010000).
summary.chinese: 去未知地图(105010000)见罗尼。

description.english: Ronnie has now asked me to hunt Fire Boars and Copper Drakes and collect 30 each of Fire Boar's Tooths and Drake Skulls. I should be able to get them from the monsters around Perion. Things are starting to get a bit tricky…

completionText.english: I got everything for Ronnie. I'm still not getting anything How many more times do I have to do this
completionText.chinese: 我收集完后给了洛尼。但是还没有报酬？这个任务什么时候才结束呢？

quests.english: Last Material for Building a New House
quests.chinese: 为盖房子需要的最后材料

summary.english: Meet Ronnie in the Unknown Map(105010000).
summary.chinese: 去未知地图(105010000)见罗尼。

description.english: Ronnie asked for the last time. This time he wanted 30 Cold Eye Tails, 10 Dragon Skins, and 1 Diamond by taking down Cold Eyes and Drakes. I can sort of get this, but for me to hunt at the deep parts of the Ant Tunnel… this is way too hard!!
description.chinese:
最后洛尼拜托我收集#b奇怪的药、黑石头、怪猫的眼睛、月牙牛魔王的角各50个和1个钻石#k。为了收集这些东西我要去地铁，幽深的森林，蚂蚁洞。这不是太难了吗？

completionText.english: I got all the materials Ronnie needed for the last time. Is this it For the reward, he gave me a scroll for shoes he got as a gift from the fairies, who found it somewhere around the forest. He couldn't figure out how to use the scroll, so I'm getting it... hopefully it works... haha...
completionText.chinese: 我最后收集完给了洛尼才结束。洛尼给了我报酬。那是妖精族在魔法密林附近的树林里拣到后送给他的鞋子。但他不能穿那鞋子，就给了我。那...没关系的吧？

quests.english: I Need Help on My Homework!

summary.english: Whenever I walk past Wing the Fairy in Ellinia, he seems to be asking for help. I wonder why...
summary.chinese: 去找魔法密林的维英，他会请求你帮一下忙…

description.english: Wing the Fairy of Ellinia seems to have a general disdain for humans. Definitely not the kind of attitude I expect from someone in need of help. He asked me if I can get him 10 Leafs, 10 Squishy Liquids, and 3 Slime Bubbles. He needs them so he can make a potion for his homework.
description.chinese:
在魔法密林遇到的维英似乎非常讨厌人类，说要请人帮忙写作业，可是态度怎么会那么差呢？需要帮他收集树枝30个、绿液球30个以及绿水灵珠10个。听说这些是制作药水的材料…话说回来，这是用在哪里的药水呢？

#t4000003# #b#c4000003##k/30 
#t4000004# #b#c4000004##k/30 
#t4000010# #b#c4000010##k/10

completionText.english: I helped Wing the Fairy of Ellinia with his homework. I have no idea how that potion works, though.
completionText.chinese: 帮魔法密林的维英完成了作业，就是帮他收集了一些药水的材料。那药水的用途到底是什么呢…？

summary.english: It looks like Shane in Ellinia is looking for an adventurer to lend a hand.
summary.chinese: 魔法密林的谢恩似乎正在寻找冒险家帮忙。

description.english: Shane in Ellinia mentioned wanting to eat a delicious mushroom dish and asked me to find some ingredients. He said Green Mushroom Caps taste especially good, so I should head out and hunt Green Mushrooms near the forest.
description.chinese: 魔法密林的谢恩说他想吃一道美味的蘑菇料理，并让我帮他找些食材。他说绿蘑菇盖特别好吃，所以我应该去森林附近狩猎绿蘑菇。

completionText.english: I gave Green Mushroom Caps to Shane in Ellinia. Can he really make a delicious meal out of this
completionText.chinese: 我把绿蘑菇盖交给了魔法密林的谢恩。他真的能用这个做出美味的料理吗？

quests.english: How to Enjoy Mushrooms Even More

summary.english: It looks like Shane in Ellinia has another favor to ask.
summary.chinese: 魔法密林的谢恩似乎还有另一个请求。

description.english: Shane in Ellinia says he learned an even better way to cook Green Mushroom Caps and asked me to bring some Green Mushroom Caps, as well as a Lemon.
description.chinese: 魔法密林的谢恩说，他学会了更好地烹饪绿蘑菇盖的方法，并让我带来一些绿蘑菇盖和一个柠檬。

completionText.english: I delivered the Green Mushroom Caps and Lemon to Shane in Ellinia. It feels like the dish might actually taste better than the last one, doesn't it
completionText.chinese: 我把绿蘑菇盖和柠檬交给了魔法密林的谢恩。感觉这道菜可能真的会比上次更好吃，不是吗？

summary.english: There is a runaway kid named Alex in Kerning City...
summary.chinese: 听说在废弃都市有离家出去的小孩子

description.english: On a lonely building rooftop in Kerning City, I met a boy named Alex who ran away from home because of a disagreement with his father, Chief Stan in Henesys. But Alex has become exhausted from being on the run with no money. Now he wants to return home and try to work things out with his strict, but loving, father. But he wants me to persuade his father not to punish him when he returns home. He also says he wants me to bring the Old Gold Watch his mother left him when she died as proof that I successfully persuaded his father.
description.chinese: 在废弃都市见到了叫阿勒斯的男孩子。他说几天前因为和严历的父亲闹别扭他离家出走了，此后就在废弃都市游荡。现在不但钱也都花光了，而且已经觉得无聊了... 但是现在回家可能父亲要打他…他拜托我说服射手村的长老(他父亲)同意他回家。他还说如果我成功说服他父亲，就拿着母亲的遗物-#b金表#k过来，他才可以相信。我不知道他为什么离家出走~！

completionText.english: As Alex requested, I looked for his father in Henesys to get Alex's mother's Old Gold Watch.
completionText.chinese: 接受阿勒斯的拜托后我为了见他父亲去射手村了.

summary.chinese: 继续进行任务：说服长老斯坦。

description.chinese:
在射手村公园入口前面见到阿勒斯的父亲斯坦长老。第一次他好凶，我一句话也说不上。但我收集来为维修村落需要的#b50个火独眼兽之尾和100个猪猪的蝴蝶结#k。

#t4000007# #b#c4000007##k/30
#t4000002# #b#c4000002##k/60

completionText.chinese: 我终于收到了阿勒斯母亲的金表

summary.chinese: 继续进行任务：母亲的金表。

description.chinese: 他比我听说的更严格。但是他和阿勒斯之间的误会终于解决了。而且收到了阿勒斯母亲的#b金表#k。

completionText.chinese: 我把那块金表给了阿勒斯。这样他就可以回家了吧。他为了表示感谢，给了我他旅游时从朋友那里得到的耳环。不过，虽然父亲原谅了他，但是他还没有马上回家的打算。下次去射手村的时候要确认一下。

summary.english: I hear that Nella at Kerning City is the one to talk to if I'm looking for work...
summary.chinese: 去废都的内拉有可以做的工作嘛。。。

description.english: I gave Nella 1000 mesos as commission for telling me about various requests from the citizens of Kerning City. The first request is from Don Hwang, the owner of the armor shop, who needs materials to craft new armor. I need to defeat 20 Orange Mushrooms and 20 Ribbon Pigs and collect 10 Orange Mushroom Caps and 10 Pig's Ribbons. It shouldn't be too hard, since Orange Mushrooms and Ribbon Pigs are commonly found near Kerning City.
description.chinese:
约定好给废弃都市的内拉1000金币，每当居民需要帮助时就委托她找人。首先防御具店老板为制造新的防具，需要收集#b50个绿蘑菇的盖#k和#b50个蓝水灵大水珠#k。绿蘑菇在工地或草丛里很常见而蓝水灵在地铁站内也很多。怎么样，不太难吧？

#t4000012# #b#c4000012##k/50
#t4000037# #b#c4000037##k/50

completionText.english: I delivered what Don Hwang asked for and got bunch of Lemons in return. I wonder what kind of armor Don Hwang will make. Nella said there are many more requests I can do. I should visit Nella every once in a while.
completionText.chinese: 帮玛帕找所需要的东西，会得到很多柠檬。很期待玛帕用那个材料做的防具吧？ 而且，可能接受新的委托。所以要求顺便进来这里… 然后，去找内拉~

summary.chinese: 继续进行任务：休咪的拜托。

description.chinese:
接受内拉的第二次委托。听在地铁站入口坐着的休咪说，想要为朋友给她的小狗造一个房子…为了造房子需要#b5个被加工过的木块#k和#b5个螺丝钉#k，所以你要找到这些材料并交给内拉。

#t4003000# #b#c4003000##k/5
#t4003001# #b#c4003001##k/5

completionText.chinese: 帮休咪找东西，会得到休咪自己做的许多蛋糕 , 希望休咪的小狗在暖和的房子里能过的好！ 然后，去找内拉~

summary.chinese: 继续进行任务：安德里亚的拜托。

description.chinese:
接受内拉的第三次委托。因为美容的助手安德里亚是老小伙儿，每顿都吃得不好， 所以她想要做海鲜汤吃… 为了做海鲜汤需要#b100个三眼章鱼触角#k和#b1个矿泉水#k。所以你要找到这些材料并交给内拉。

#t4000006# #b#c4000006##k/100
#t2022000# #b#c2022000##k/1

completionText.chinese: 帮安德里亚找所需要的东西，会得到被安德里亚加固的一双手套 , 安德里亚也没什么心事了吧? 后来有时间 去找内拉~

summary.chinese: 继续进行任务：药店老板的拜托。

description.chinese:
很久没见的内拉看到不断成长的我交给一个有点难的委托。首先药店老板在研究药水的过程中将材料用完了，非常难过。听说他还差#b100个刺蘑菇的盖#k和#b50个青蛇皮#k… 有点儿别扭，可是不太难吧？

#t4000015# #b#c4000015##k/100
#t4000034# #b#c4000034##k/50

completionText.chinese: 帮药店老板找所需要的东西，会得到多个白色药水。很期待铭仁用那些材料做出的药水！而且可能接受新的委托，所以要求顺便进来这里… 然后，去找内拉~

summary.chinese: 继续进行任务：克利思。

description.chinese:
接受内拉的第二次委托。听说铁器店的皮奥最爱用的枕头最近被偷了， 所以一直没有睡好… 为了做一个新枕头需要#b50个硬羽毛#k和#b20个动物的皮革#k。 取得后交给内拉。

#t4003004# #b#c4003004##k/50
#t4000021# #b#c4000021##k/20

completionText.chinese: 帮皮奥找所需要东西，会得到皮奥精心冶炼的钢铁和青铜。皮奥应该会睡得很好吧? 然后，去找内拉~

summary.chinese: 继续进行任务：曼斯塔的拜托。

description.chinese: 接受内拉的第三次委托。护身用品店的主人曼斯塔是个很特别的美食家，听说他需要烤火独眼兽尾的材料… 他只想要#b150个火独眼兽之尾#k，就可以做很久的饭菜……取得后交给内拉。\n\n#t4000007# #b#c4000007##k/150

completionText.chinese: 帮曼斯塔托找所需要的东西，会得到一双坚固的鞋。这些材料也够曼斯塔也能做一阵子饭菜吧? 然后，去找内拉~

summary.english: I heard there is someone in Niora Hospital in Kerning City...
summary.chinese: 听说在废弃都市的闹拉医院里有人…

description.english: I met Jane Doe in Niora Hospital in Kerning City. Jane Doe needed to take off the bandages to see the surgery result, but there was no mirror. Jane Doe asked me to defeat 40 Stirges and collect 20 Broken Mirror Glasss...
description.chinese: 在废弃都市的闹拉医院见到了#b#p1052105##k．她想知道手术的结果，要打开绷带，但她现在没有镜子．所以她拜托我打猎野猪后收集#b20个#t4031155##k来. \n\n#t4031155#  #b#c4031155##k / 20

completionText.english: For the Stranger I met in Niora Hospital, I actually collected Broken Mirror Glass and brought it back to her.
completionText.chinese: 我收集齐#t4031155#后给闹拉医院的陌生女人了.

summary.chinese: 继续进行任务：陌生女人的真相。

description.chinese: 在闹拉医院见到的那女人原来是幽灵!! 她不知道她已经死了，还在医院等医生…她为了复活拜托我收集#b100个#t4000008##k来…但是有了这些东西她真的能复活吗?\n\n#t4000008#  #b#c4000008##k / 100

completionText.chinese: 在闹拉医院见到的#p1052105#原来是幽灵.我为她收集#t4000008#来了.但有这些东西, 她还不能复活… 希望她能去个好地方.

summary.english: It seems that Lakelis in Kerning City is looking for a party to take on a party quest that requires multiple adventurers to work together.
summary.chinese: 废弃都市的拉克莉丝似乎正在寻找队伍，挑战一个需要多名冒险家合作完成的组队任务。

description.english: Lakelis in Kerning City asked me to challenge the party quest "First Time Together” and defeat the King Slime inside. The party quest must be attempted by a party of four adventurers, all level 21 or higher. Once the party is ready, the party leader should speak to Lakelis. Better start looking for some friends to join me.
description.chinese: 废弃都市的拉克莉丝让我挑战组队任务“一起第一次”，并打败里面的巨大绿水灵。这个组队任务必须由4名21级以上的冒险家组成队伍才能挑战。队伍准备好后，队长应该去和拉克莉丝对话。看来我得先去找些朋友加入我了。

completionText.english: As requested by Lakelis, my friends and I challenged the party quest "First Time Together” and defeated King Slime. When everyone works together, there’s nothing that can’t be done!
completionText.chinese: 按照拉克莉丝的请求，我和朋友们挑战了组队任务“一起第一次”，并打败了巨大绿水灵。只要大家齐心协力，就没有什么做不到！

summary.english: Let's start looking for Shumi in Kerning City.
summary.chinese: 先去废弃都市找休咪吧。

description.english: I met this girl named Shumi in Kerning City. She was devastated about losing the lucky coin that she borrowed from a friend, and she asked me to find it for her. She also told me that a bunch of guys draped in white cloth took it from her in the subway, and that I might find them at the Construction Site B1, deep in the station... I should go there first...
description.chinese: 我在废弃都市遇见了一个叫休咪的女孩。她因为弄丢了从朋友那里借来的幸运硬币而非常崩溃，并拜托我帮她找回来。她还说，有一群披着白布的家伙在地铁里把硬币从她那里抢走了，我可能能在车站深处的工地B1找到它们……我应该先去那里看看……

completionText.english: I found the lost coin that Shumi of Kerning City was looking for, and returned it to her. A precious coin borrowed from her friend, huh... as a reward, she gave me a bunch of return scrolls... not bad at all!! She also said other items can be found at Construction Site B1... I should check it out later...
completionText.chinese: 我找到了废弃都市休咪丢失的硬币，并还给了她。从朋友那里借来的珍贵硬币啊……作为奖励，她给了我一堆回城卷轴……还不错！！她还说工地B1里还能找到其他东西……以后我应该再去看看……

quests.english: [Construction Site B2] Shumi's Lost Roll of Cash

summary.english: Let's go look for Shumi in Kerning City.
summary.chinese: 去废弃都市找休咪吧。

description.english: I ran into Shumi again in Kerning City. She seemed really worried about how she lost her rent money because a Stirge flew over and snatched a bundle of money away from her. Man... do I have to walk back in there again... can I just pay the rent for her Anyway like last time, I need to go back in there, this time to Construction Site B2 and find the bundle of money she lost. Aye, better go in there now...
description.chinese: 我又在废弃都市遇见了休咪。她看起来非常担心，因为一只蝙蝠飞过来，把她的房租钱抢走了。唉……我还得再走进去一次吗……我能不能直接替她付房租算了？总之，和上次一样，我得再进去一次，这次要去工地B2，找回她弄丢的那卷现金。唉，还是赶紧进去吧……

completionText.english: I got Shumi from Kerning City the lost bundle of money. Guess she can pay her rent now... and as a reward, she got me 30 Blue Potions... She also said I can find other items at the Construction Site B2... I should go check it out sometime...
completionText.chinese: 我帮废弃都市的休咪找回了丢失的一卷现金。看来她现在能付房租了……作为奖励，她给了我30瓶蓝色药水……她还说工地B2里可以找到其他物品……有空我应该去看看……

quests.english: [Construction Site B3] Shumi's Lost Sack of Cash

summary.english: Let's go look for Shumi in Kerning City.
summary.chinese: 去废弃都市找休咪吧。

description.english: I ran into Shumi again at Kerning City. A while ago, she got a favor from JM From tha Streetz to get some Screws for him, only to have the sack of money fall down and lose everything in the process. I guess I can find the sack of money in the deep part of the subway station, the Construction Site B3, again.
description.chinese: 我又在废弃都市遇见了休咪。前阵子，她受街头的JM之托，要帮他买一些螺丝，结果钱袋掉了下去，里面的钱全都丢了。我想我应该能在地铁站深处的工地B3，再次找到那个钱袋。

completionText.english: I found Shumi's lost Money Sack in the Kerning City subway. Shumi can now buy what JM From tha Streetz asked for. I received mesos and some potions as a gift. I should go to Construction Site B3 in the subway to look for more stuff.
completionText.chinese: 我在废弃都市地铁里找到了休咪丢失的钱袋。休咪现在可以去买街头的JM要的东西了。我收到了金币和一些药水作为礼物。我应该去地铁的工地B3找找看还有没有更多东西。

summary.english: I should go see Icarus, who's at the top of a building in Kerning City. He seems to be bored out of his mind.
summary.chinese: 我去废弃都市建筑物的最上方找伊卡路斯聊一下好了！他好像觉得很无聊…

description.english: I got to talk to Icarus in Kerning City. Just what exactly is he doing staring aimlessly at the sky anyway He seemed to be really bored, and asked me if I can answer his questions.
description.chinese: 在废弃都市见到了伊卡路斯，真搞不懂他在屋顶上到底想干啥…看来他今天觉得很无聊吧，对路过的我提出了一些问题。

completionText.english: I answered all the questions that Icarus of Kerning City asked. That was easy.
completionText.chinese: 废弃都市的伊卡路斯…我把它提出的问题全部答对了。

summary.english: I answered all the questions that Icarus of Kerning City asked. That was easy.
summary.chinese: 答对伊卡路斯提出的所有问题了。

description.english: I answered all of Icarus's questions, but he still seemed bored out of his mind. He asked me if I could get him a toy that he could play around with.
description.chinese:
废弃都市的伊卡路斯…我已经将他提出的问题全部答对，可他还是直说无聊。他要我帮他找到可以在屋顶玩的玩具。

#t4000003# #b#c4000003##k/40 
#t4000004# #b#c4000004##k/40

completionText.english: I had fun playing around with Icarus.
completionText.chinese: 与无聊的伊卡路斯度过了一段快乐的时光。

summary.english: Apparently there's someone in Kerning City by the name of Icarus that stands on top of a building just staring at the sky 24/7.
summary.chinese: 到废弃都市，就可以见到在建筑物屋顶终日望着天空的#p1052106#…

description.english: I got to meet Icarus on top of a building at Kerning City. He seems like a nice guy who has an unquenchable thirst for flying, and he wants to create a hang glider to fulfill his dream of flying. He asks me if I can gather up the materials for the hang glider, and even though the process of making the hang glider seems dubious at best, I can't say no to his sincere desire to fly. I'll need to get him 30 Stirge Wings, 10 Processed Woods, and 15 Stiff Feathers.
description.chinese:
在废弃都市某栋建筑顶楼遇到了#b#p1052106##k，他提议说要制作滑翔翼来遨游天空。虽然不太可靠，但拥有梦想并想要飞向天空的#p1052106#，他的毅力还真令人佩服。那我来帮伊卡路斯收集#b#t4000042# 50个、 #t4003001# 10个、#t4003004# 50个#k好了，让他可以制作出梦想中的滑翔翼。

#t4000042#  #b#c4000042##k / 50
#t4003001#  #b#c4003001##k / 10
#t4003004#  #b#c4003004##k / 50

completionText.english: I got the materials needed for Icarus to make the hang glider and realize his dream of flying. I just wonder if Stirge wings are enough to make the hang glider. I don't know if this will really work, but he might end up succeeding, so I should check up on him around the time the hang glider should be ready to take flight.
completionText.chinese: 梦想可以飞向天空的#p1052106#说要制作滑翔翼，因此我帮他收集材料后交给了他。真的可以用蝙蝠的翅膀来做出滑翔翼吗？虽然有点怀疑，但也许会有奇迹出现，那我在伊卡路斯快要完成滑翔翼时再来找他好了！

summary.english: I wonder how Icarus's doing with the hang glider... Maybe I should go check up on him in Kerning City.
summary.chinese: 不知道说要制作滑翔翼的伊卡路斯现在怎么样了…要不要再到废弃都市去见见伊卡路斯呢？

description.english: Icarus failed to create a working hang glider, and is now attempting to create a flying balloon on his never-ending quest for flight. This looks just as preposterous as his last attempt, but I don't think I can stop him. To make the flying balloon, he needs 50 Tablecloths and 10 Alligator Skin Pouchs. Hope this works...
description.chinese:
制作滑翔翼失败的伊卡路斯…这次说要做出热气球来翱翔天空。虽然这次看起来也太冒险，但看来也无法说服伊卡路斯了。这次为了制作热气球，说是希望帮她收集#b#t4000035# 100个#k与#b#t4031164# 10个#k，不知道这次会不会成功啊…

#t4000035#  #b#c4000035##k / 100
#t4031164#  #b#c4031164##k / 10

completionText.english: I got the materials needed for Icarus to make the flying balloon and realize his dream of flying. I don't know if his "flying balloon" will actually fly, but there's a chance that it might work. I'll check up on him around when the flying balloon should be ready to take flight and see if he's for real this time.
completionText.chinese: 梦想着可以在天空飞翔的伊卡路斯，这次想要挑战制作热气球，因此帮他收集材料后拿给了他。究竟伊卡路斯能否制作出可以飞上天空的热气球呢？虽然还是不太能相信，但搞不好这次真的会成功…在伊卡路斯快完成热气球之前，再去见见他好了。

quests.english: In search of Wing the Fairy

summary.english: I wonder how Icarus's doing with the flying balloon... Maybe I should go check up on him in Kerning City.
summary.chinese: 魔法密林的#b妖精维英#k希望将好不容易制作完成的药水转交给伊卡路斯。只要有这个药，伊卡路斯就可以飞上天空了吗？好！那得赶快交给伊卡路斯…

description.english: Icarus failed to make the flying balloon, but his never-ending quest for flight continues. This time he wants to deviate from a scientific approach to flight and opt for a magical approach, and asks me to see his best friend Wing the Fairy in Ellinia, the town of fairies. Apparently Wing the Fairy knows how to make Flying Medicine... I'll need to see that fairy in Ellinia for Icarus's sake.
description.chinese: 为了完成伊卡路斯想要飞向天空的梦想，所以要将魔法密林的妖精维英所制作的飞天药水转交给伊卡路斯。不知道药效如何…

completionText.english: Wing the Fairy in Ellinia seemed to dislike humans so much that he wouldn’t even listen to what I had to say.
completionText.chinese: 魔法密林的妖精维英似乎非常讨厌人类，甚至不愿听我说话。

quests.english: The Ingredients for the Flying Pill

summary.english: It doesn’t seem easy to talk to Wing the Fairy.
summary.chinese: 和妖精维英说话似乎并不容易。

description.english: I met Wing the Fairy in Ellinia, and he doesn't seem to like people in general. How is he best friends with Icarus in the first place Anyway, he says in order to make the Flying Medicine, he's going to need 50 Medicine With Weird Vibes and 20 Witchgrass Leafs. So that's all it takes
description.chinese:
在魔法密林遇到的妖精维英好像很讨厌人类，可是他怎么会和伊卡路斯成为朋友的呢？维英说，如果要制作 #b#t4031163##k，需要#b#t4000036# 50个#k和#b#t4031165# 20个#k，这表示只要收集这些东西，就可以帮我制作药水吗？

#t4000036#  #b#c4000036##k / 50
#t4031165#  #b#c4031165##k / 20

completionText.english: As Wing the Fairy asked, I got him Medicine With Weird Vibes and Witchgrass Leafs. Can he make Flying Medicine with these
completionText.chinese: 按照妖精维英的要求，我收集了奇怪的药和魔草叶。他能用这些做出飞天药水吗？

summary.english: It looks like the Flying Medicine that will finally fulfill Icarus’s dream has been completed.
summary.chinese: 看来能实现伊卡路斯梦想的飞天药水终于完成了。

description.english: Wing the Fairy of Ellinia asked me to take the Flying Medicine to Icarus. So this little pill is all it takes to fly I need to get this to Icarus ASAP.
description.chinese: 魔法密林的#b妖精维英#k希望将好不容易制作完成的药水转交给伊卡路斯。只要有这个药，伊卡路斯就可以飞上天空了吗？好！那得赶快交给伊卡路斯…

completionText.english: I got Icarus the Flying Medicine that Wing the Fairy of Ellinia made. I hope it works for him.
completionText.chinese: 为了完成伊卡路斯想要飞向天空的梦想，所以要将魔法密林的妖精维英所制作的飞天药水转交给伊卡路斯。不知道药效如何…

summary.english: I heard that "Blackbull" in Perion is fixing up his house.
summary.chinese: 勇士部落的酋长要修房子。。。

description.english: Right here, in this dusty town of Perion, I ran into an oddly-dressed man named "Blackbull." He told me he needs to fix his house and wondered if I could help him out by defeating 20 Stumps and 20 Dark Stumps and getting him 10 Tree Branches and 10 Leafs. If I do him a favor, I'll get a nice shield from him, but what if I say no I wouldn't... be... EATEN BY HIM... no I really hope not...
description.chinese:
荒凉的高原村勇士部落。。。 在那里我见到了酋长，他穿得真奇怪。他拜托我收集为修理房子所需要的#b30个树枝和50个木块#k来。要是我答应他的请求，我就可以得到他的盾牌。但我不答应的话，难道他真会吃了我？

#t4000018# #b#c4000018##k/50
#t4000003# #b#c4000003##k/30

completionText.english: I got "Blackbull" of Perion 10 Tree Branches and 10 Leafs after defeating 20 Stumps and 20 Dark Stumps. With these, he can finally fix his house. I got this shield as a reward... and... well, scratch marks here and there, and it looks pretty old... is this even usable
completionText.chinese: 收集完#b30个树枝和50个木块#k给勇士部落的酋长了。用这些材料他可以修理房子了。作为答礼我收到了他的盾牌，那盾牌的很多地方有伤痕。看起来好像是很旧的，这么旧的盾牌就这样用没关系吗？

quests.english: Building a New House For Blackbull

summary.english: I heard that "Blackbull" in Perion is building a new house...
summary.chinese: 勇士部落的酋长这次要盖新房子。。。

description.english: I ran into "Blackbull" again, the guy whose house I helped fix. He was surprised at how strong I looked and asked me for a much harder favor. His cousins from Henesys are all trying to move to Perion, so he needs to build a new house! To build a new house, he said he needed 100 Stone Golem Rubbles, 30 Screws, 30 Processed Wood, and "Blackbull's" deed to the land. His son had the deed to the land, but it was stolen by Curse Eyes near Sleepywood... hmmm... I should be looking for those wandering around the deep forest...
description.chinese:
我又去找以前帮过他的酋长。他看我这么强的样子，好像很吃惊。但他这次拜托我更难问题。因为住在射手村的亲戚们都要搬来，需要新的房子。他说为了盖新房子，需要#b100个石头人的石头，30个木材，30个螺丝钉，一张地契#k。但是上次他儿子拿着地契，在林中之城附近被风独眼兽抢走了。我只好去沼泽地找它们算帐。

#t4000022# #b#c4000022##k/100
#t4003000# #b#c4003000##k/30
#t4003001# #b#c4003001##k/30
#t4001004# #b#c4001004##k/1

completionText.english: So that all of "Blackbull's" cousins could move to Perion, I got him the items he requested. It was really tough, and I hope he doesn't ask me to BUILD a house for him next time...
completionText.chinese: 我把#b100个石头人的石头，30个木材，30个螺丝钉，一张地契#k都交给了酋长。难道我这次都收集来了这么多的材料，他还会让我找另外材料？他为表示感谢给了我一些经验值和15000金币和10%成功率的武器卷轴。人气度也上升2点，这算是蛮好的报酬。

summary.english: Find Manji in Perion.
summary.chinese: 去勇士部落找曼吉。

description.english: I came across Manji again, whom I had first met in Perion when making the medicine for Maya, the little girl in Henesys. Surprised at how much stronger I had become, Manji asked me for a favor. Long ago, when he was in danger of being struck down by Balrog, he was saved by the legendary hero Tristan, who died in his place. Ever since then, Manji had held onto Tristan’s sword. But the blade, corrupted by Balrog’s evil aura, has become so worn down that it can hardly even be called a sword anymore… Manji handed me the Old Gladius he had been keeping and asked me to awaken it back to its true form. Once fully awakened, it is said to become the Hero's Gladius. Just as Manji said, I should seek out Chrishrama in Sleepywood.
description.chinese: 我又遇见了曼吉。当初为了给射手村的小女孩玛雅制作药时，我曾在勇士部落见过他。看到我变强了这么多，曼吉有些惊讶，并拜托我一件事。很久以前，曼吉差点被蝙蝠魔击倒，是传说中的英雄特里斯坦救了他，并代替他死去。从那以后，曼吉一直保管着特里斯坦的剑。但那把剑受到蝙蝠魔邪恶气息的侵蚀，刀刃已经磨损得几乎不能被称为剑了……曼吉把他一直保管的旧军刀交给我，并请我将它唤醒成真正的形态。据说完全觉醒后，它会变成英雄军刀。就像曼吉说的那样，我应该去林中之城找克里斯拉玛。

completionText.english: I met Chrishrama in Sleepywood and was able to ask him how to awaken the Old Gladius.
completionText.chinese: 我在林中之城见到了克里斯拉玛，并向他询问了唤醒旧军刀的方法。

summary.english: See Chrishrama in Sleepywood to awaken the Old Gladius.
summary.chinese: 去林中之城见克里斯拉玛，唤醒旧军刀。

description.english: I showed Chrishrama Manji's Old Gladius, and he claimed to have made it himself. He said he needs 1 Star Rock, 1 Piece of Ice, 1 Ancient Scroll, and 1 Flaming Feather to awaken it. Unfortunately, I've never heard of any of those items... He recommended talking to Mike in Perion Dungeon Entrance to find them.
description.chinese: 我把曼吉的旧军刀拿给克里斯拉玛看，他声称这把剑是他亲手打造的。他说要唤醒它，需要1个星石、1块冰块、1张古代卷轴和1根火焰羽毛。遗憾的是，我从没听说过这些东西……他建议我去勇士部落地牢入口找麦克打听。

completionText.english: I gathered the materials needed for the awakening and took them to Chrishrama. Chrishrama used the materials to reawaken the Old Gladius into the Hero's Gladius. It's a nice sword radiating a mysterious light... It's a shame I have to give it to Manji.
completionText.chinese: 我收集齐了觉醒所需的材料，并把它们带给了克里斯拉玛。克里斯拉玛用这些材料将旧军刀重新唤醒成了英雄军刀。这是一把散发着神秘光芒的好剑……可惜我必须把它交给曼吉。

summary.english: After much hardship, I finally managed to gather all the materials Chrishrama asked for. Now, I can only trust in his power.
summary.chinese: 要去见勇士部落的麦吉

description.english: With Chrishrama’s help, I was able to awaken the Old Gladius entrusted by Manji into the Hero's Gladius. All that remains is to return the sword to Manji.
description.chinese: 在勇士部落又见到了麦吉。他看我变成这么强大，好像很吃惊的样子。他拜托我一件事儿。以前他遇见过蝙蝠怪，从前他遇到危险的时候，传说中的英雄特里斯坦救他的命，为此他牺牲了。从那时候他一直保管特里斯坦的剑。但是那把剑受到了蝙蝠怪的邪恶能力的影响，已经沉睡了。麦吉给我那把#b旧战剑#k让我想办法唤醒这把剑。他说要是它完全觉醒的话，就会变成#b英雄战剑#k。我要根据麦吉说的去见林中之城的克利斯拉玛。

completionText.english: It seems that this Hero's Gladius which Manji told me about is one fine sword. I had to make a hard decision choosing between the Hero's Gladius and the Skull Earrings that Manji offered me, but I will not regret my choice.
completionText.chinese: 看来英雄战剑是非常优秀的剑。我不得不选择英雄战剑和麦吉要给我的白骨耳环了。但我没后悔我的选择。

summary.english: I heard that Winston the archeologist is searching for something in the Rocky Mountains on the east side of Perion...
summary.chinese: 勇士部落附近的东部岩山的考古学家#p1022006#在找什么。。。

description.english: Winston, the archeologist who I ran into in the rocky mountains on the east side of Perion, said he lost the fossils he collected near Perion. He asked me to bring back 12 Animal Fossils and 12 Plant Fossils that were taken by Green Mushrooms and Axe Stumps. How can he lose something so important like that He's more careless than he looks...

completionText.english: I found the fossils that Winston lost.
completionText.chinese: 我找回化石给#b#p1022006##k了.

summary.english: It seems the archaeologist Winston in the Rocky Mountains on the East side of Perion has another request.
summary.chinese: 勇士部落东侧洛基山脉的考古学家温斯顿似乎还有另一个请求。

description.english: Winston the Archeologist said that it is not safe to leave the valuable fossils in the tent. He asked me to take the fossils and deliver them to Dr. Betty in Ellinia. He also wrote a letter of introduction for me to show her.
description.chinese: 考古学家温斯顿说，把珍贵的化石留在帐篷里并不安全。他让我把化石带走，送到魔法密林的贝蒂博士那里。他还写了一封介绍信，让我拿给她看。

completionText.english: Winston the Archeologist in Perion said that it is not safe to leave the valuable fossils in his tent. He asked me to deliver them to Dr. Betty in Ellinia. Dr. Betty said she's going to be really busy from now, and she asked me to stop by again and give her a hand afterwards. Fossils huh... Should I give it a try
completionText.chinese: 勇士部落的考古学家温斯顿说，把珍贵的化石留在帐篷里并不安全。他让我把化石送到魔法密林的贝蒂博士那里。贝蒂博士说她接下来会非常忙，并让我之后再来帮她。化石啊……我要不要试试看呢？

summary.english: Dr. Betty, a biologist near Ellinia, is looking for an assistant.
summary.chinese: 听说魔法密林的生物学家巴缇博士需要助手。。。

description.english: Dr. Betty asked me to work as an assistant for a while. My first task from her is to collect 20 Plant Samples. I can see various plants covering the woods in Ellinia.
description.chinese: 巴缇博士要开始植物化石研究，但现在没有植物的样品不能进行研究。所以她拜托我为她收集#b20个#t4031150##k。\n\n#t4031150#  #b#c4031150##k / 20

completionText.english: My first job as Dr. Betty's assistant was to collect some plants in the woods in Ellinia and sample them. It wasn't that hard, I guess.
completionText.chinese: 作为巴缇博士的助手，我的第一个任务是收集植物样品。这很容易弄到。

summary.english: It seems the biologist Dr. Betty near Ellinia has another request.
summary.chinese: 魔法密林附近的生物学家贝蒂博士似乎还有另一个请求。

description.english: Dr. Betty in Ellinia told me that she needs 1 Stuffed Drake Skull for her research. She asked me to find her daughter near Henesys, and bring it back to her. Where would Anne be
description.chinese: 巴缇博士说为了研究动物化石需要#b一个#t4031151##k。在射手村附近他的女儿桉保管这个。桉在哪里？

completionText.english: I met Dr. Betty's daughter, Anne, playing near Henesys by herself.
completionText.chinese: 我见到了贝蒂博士的女儿安妮，她一个人在射手村附近玩耍。

summary.english: It looks like Anne has the item that Dr. Betty needs.
summary.chinese: 看来安妮手里有贝蒂博士需要的物品。

description.english: I received the Stuffed Drake Skull from Anne, Dr. Betty's daughter. Now I have to deliver this carefully to Dr. Betty...
description.chinese: 从巴缇博士的女儿桉那里拿到了#t4031151#。那么我要把这个物品拿回去给巴缇博士。

completionText.english: I collected some Plant Samples and a Stuffed Drake Skull to help Dr. Betty's research on fossils. I can't wait to see the results... I should go and see Dr. Betty, because she said she would tell me when I go back.
completionText.chinese: 帮巴缇博士找到了研究需要的植物样品和被剥制的龙之头骨。我也很期待研究结果。那么以后我再去巴缇博士那里。她会告诉我研究结果吧。

summary.english: I heard Dr. Betty has finished her fossil research. Maybe I should go and see the results.
summary.chinese: 听说魔法密林的巴缇博士完成了化石研究。。。

description.english: I met Dr. Betty again. She told me the research was finished and explained it to me, then asked me to take the research report and deliver it to Dr. Winston in Perion. Dr. Betty also informed me that if I take 20 Leafs, 15 Firewoods, 1 Stump's Teardrop, and 1 pair of Weighted Earrings, Dr. Winston would be really happy.

completionText.english: I delivered Dr. Betty's Fossil Report to Dr. Winston in Perion. Along with the report, I also gave him the Leafs, Firewoods, Stump's Teardrop, and Weighted Earrings. In return, Dr. Winston gave me the Leaf Earrings.
completionText.chinese: 把巴缇博士的化石研究报告书和#t4000018##k，#t4031153##k，#t1032000##k送给了勇士部落的芳博士，他就给了我叶子耳环．

summary.english: Ayan of Perion says she can't take one step out of town. I wonder why...
summary.chinese: 听说住在勇士部落的伊安无法踏出村庄一步…

description.english: I met Ayan in Perion. Apparently, she cannot remember anything about her childhood, and she lives everyday in fear of Stumps. She's so scared that she can't even dare to look at them. Due to this paralyzing fear of Stumps, she cannot take one step out of Perion, and asks me to take them out for her sake. Are they really THAT scary
description.chinese: 见到了住在勇士部落的伊安，她虽然没有纯正的印第安血统，但仍住在勇士部落。也许她曾经经历过痛苦的事情，使得她完全没有小时候的记忆。她非常害怕木妖，听说看着木妖得眼睛，就会感到莫名的恐惧…因为这股莫名的恐惧而无法踏出村庄的她，拜托我帮她打倒木妖…木妖有这么可怕吗？\n\n#o0130100# #r#a20821##k

completionText.english: I took out Stumps for Ayan's sake in Perion. She can finally venture outside without having to worry about them!
completionText.chinese: 替居住在勇士部落的伊安打倒了木妖，但愿从此以后她可以安心的到村外走走。

summary.english: I heard something happened to the tribespeople of Perion. I should go ask Ayan about this.
summary.chinese: 听说勇士部落的印第安人发生了一些事情…得去找伊安问个究竟。

description.english: I met up with Ayan in Perion. She told me that a few days ago, a group of tribespeople went hunting in the swamp and wound up being ambushed by a group of alligators. She was worried about the sudden surge of alligators taking over the swamp and asked me to reduce their numbers before they spawn out of control. I'll have to kill 100 Ligators and 40 Jr. Neckis and pick up 20 Jr. Necki Skins along the way.
description.chinese:
在勇士部落找到了伊安，她说前不久去沼泽地打猎的印第安人受到鳄鱼的袭击，希望可以帮忙消灭数量变得过多的鳄鱼。首先需要打倒#b#o3110100# 250只#k和#b#o2130103# 40只#k，并收集 #b#t4000034# 20个#k后再交给她。

#o3110100#  #r#a20942##k
#o2130103#  #r#a20941##k
#t4000034#  #b#c4000034##k / 20

completionText.english: The tribespeople of Perion got ambushed by the alligator herd at the swamp, so Ayan asked if I could help take care of the alligators. I responded by taking out 100 Ligators and 40 Jr. Neckis. Hopefully this will bring some peace back to the swamp.
completionText.chinese: 勇士部落的印第安人受到沼泽地鳄鱼的袭击，受到伊安所托，前往沼泽地打倒了#b#o3110100#250只#k和#b#o2130103# 40只#k。但愿沼泽地区可以恢复平静…

summary.english: Ayan of Perion is desperately looking for me. Is something wrong
summary.chinese: 勇士部落的伊安好像有急事找我，不晓得是不是出了什么问题…

description.english: I found Ayan, and she seemed to be panicking. She was walking around the swamp when she ran into a bigger, stronger, and more dangerous group of alligators than the previous one. She ran back to Perion and has been looking for me to ask me for help ever since. This time, I'll need to kill 120 Crocos and bring back 50 Croco Skins along the way.
description.chinese:
再次见到了伊安，她说在沼泽深处发现了更凶暴的鳄鱼，希望我可以再帮她一次。这次需要打倒#b#o5130103# 120只#k，并将#b#t4000033# 50个#k交给她。

#o5130103#  #r#a20951##k
#t4000033#  #b#c4000033##k / 50

completionText.english: At Ayan's request, I took out 120 Crocos in the swamp. I'll have to revisit that spot from time to time and take out the alligators before they spawn out of control.
completionText.chinese: 收到伊安的请求，帮她打倒住在沼泽的#o5130103# 120只。看来为了防止鳄鱼的数量不断增加，我得到沼泽地带消灭这些怪物了！

quests.english: A Clue to the Secret Book

summary.english: I heard Mr. Wetbottom in Sleepywood is going through hard times... I should go check on him.
summary.chinese: 最近林中之城的泰索夫有了困难。。。

description.english: At the VIP sauna in Sleepywood, I met this bald man called Mr. Wetbottom. He has a son, and apparently he ran away from home one day with a book that he cares deeply for. He requested that I find his son and get the book back from him. For a reward, he's offering me a nice sauna robe. He also told me his son Ronnie hangs out at a tree tunnel around Ellinia, so maybe I can find him there. Anyway, is that book more important to him than his son What kind of a book is it anyway...
description.chinese: 在林中之城的高级桑拿房里遇见了叫#b泰素夫#k的秃头叔叔。他说他有一个儿子几天前拿着他最喜爱的书离家出走了。然后拜托我找到他的儿子拿回那本书。要是我找到他那本书，他会给我一件很实用的衣服。他又告诉我他的儿子洛尼常常去魔法密林附近的树林通道。所以我去那里找，应该能找到。不过，那本书比儿子还重要吗？到底是什么样的书啊...?!?!

completionText.english: I found Ronnie in the tree tunnel of Ellinia, as requested by Mr. Wetbottom, whom I met at the VIP Sauna.
completionText.chinese: 在魔法密林附近的树林里找到了泰索夫的儿子

summary.chinese: 继续进行任务：肚子饿得洛尼。

description.chinese: 在魔法密林的树林通道里找到了泰素夫的儿子#b洛尼#k。第一次他跟我说他绝不能给我那本红色的书。不过他看起来很饿？最后跟我约好，要是我给他#b50个猴子的香蕉和丽娜的特质烤鳗鱼和新鲜的牛奶#k，就给我书。按照露妮说的，丽娜在射手村可以找到，新鲜的牛奶从魔法密林的妖精可以得到。虽然有点麻烦，但我还是要去…

completionText.chinese: 把所有的菜都给洛尼后，收到了泰素夫喜爱的#b那本秘密书#k。是一本封面图片很奇怪的红色书。我应不应该打开看看？我还是快点把这本书送给林中之城里高级桑拿房的泰素夫吧。

summary.chinese: 继续进行任务：还是很饿的罗尼。

completionText.chinese: 我交给泰素夫他非常喜爱的那本书。我问了他担不担心洛尼，但他说因为洛尼和妖精族在一起他不担心。。。也许对洛尼来说跟妖精族在一起会更好吧？他为表示感谢给了我一件桑拿服。在桑拿房里穿铠甲确实不方便。我这次收到了这么实用的衣服，就慢慢洗桑拿吧。

quests.english: [Forest of Patience] Sabitrama and the Diet Medicine
quests.chinese: 【忍耐之林】萨比特拉玛和减肥药

summary.english: Let's go look for Sabitrama in Sleepywood.
summary.chinese: 去林中之城找萨比特拉玛吧。

description.english: In front of the Sleepywood Hotel, I met Sabitrama, a medicinal herb trader who seems to be the younger brother of Chrishrama. He said he found a place where he can finally find the herb that he needed for this medicine he's working on... and he asked if I could go in that forest and grab an herb called Pink Anthurium. It consists of green grass and a small pink flower... I should remember this well and get him the exact same one. I heard the place is near Ellinia... I should go there and talk to this guy Shane...
description.chinese: 在林中之城旅馆前，我遇见了萨比特拉玛，一个药草商人，他似乎是克里斯拉玛的弟弟。他说他终于找到了能采到制作药物所需药草的地方……于是问我能不能去那片森林里帮他采一种叫粉色火鹤花的药草。它由绿色草叶和一朵小小的粉色花组成……我得好好记住这个样子，采到完全一样的才行。听说那个地方在魔法密林附近……我应该去那里找谢恩谈谈……

completionText.english: Thankfully I got the flower that Sabitrama wanted from the Forest of Patience, and as a sign of appreciation, he gave me a scroll for overall armor. Oh, and he also said that from here on out, I can enter the Forest of Patience without having to pay Shane of Ellinia. From what I've heard, the diet medicine Sabitrama's working on is for Shane's fiance... I better get back in the Forest of Patience when I have some time...
completionText.chinese: 幸好我从忍耐之林采到了萨比特拉玛想要的花。作为感谢，他给了我一张全身铠甲卷轴。哦，他还说从现在开始，我可以不用付钱给魔法密林的谢恩，就能进入忍耐之林。听说萨比特拉玛正在制作的减肥药是给谢恩的未婚妻用的……有时间的话，我应该再去忍耐之林看看……

quests.chinese: 【忍耐之林】萨比特拉玛的不老药

summary.english: I heard that Sabitrama in Sleepywood is making a new medicine...
summary.chinese: 听说林中之城的萨比特拉玛正在制作一种新药……

description.english: I ran into Sabitrama again in front of the Sleepywood Hotel, the same one I helped get herbs before. This time, he said he found a place where I can get an important herb that he needed for his new medicine. He asked me if I could go into that forest and grab Double-Rooted Red Ginseng for him. It was a reddish root split in two... I should remember it well and find the same one once I get to the top. The herb is in the forest owned by Shane of Ellinia, whom I visited last time...
description.chinese: 我又在林中之城旅馆前遇见了萨比特拉玛，就是之前我帮他采药的那个人。这一次，他说自己找到了一个地方，可以采到制作新药所需的重要药草。他问我能不能进入那片森林，帮他采来双根红参。它是一种红色、分成两股的根……我得好好记住它的样子，到达顶端后找到完全一样的。那种药草就在魔法密林谢恩拥有的森林里，也就是我上次去过的地方……

completionText.english: Thankfully I got the herb that Sabitrama asked me to get, and for that, I got rewarded with a mysterious rock. And from here on out, I don't have to pay Shane every time I go in the Forest of Patience. From what I hear, that anti-aging medicine Sabitrama is working on may be what Shane needed... if I have time, I should go back in there...
completionText.chinese: 幸好我采到了萨比特拉玛要的药草，并因此得到了一块神秘的石头作为奖励。从现在开始，我每次进入忍耐之林时都不用再付钱给谢恩了。听说萨比特拉玛正在制作的不老药，可能正是谢恩需要的东西……如果有时间，我应该再回去看看……

summary.english: The cave fairy Zelya in the Forgotten Hollow seems to have a request. But even finding where the Forgotten Hollow is located may be a challenge in itself...
summary.chinese: 遗忘空洞里的洞穴妖精泽莉娅似乎有事相求。不过光是找到遗忘空洞的位置，可能就已经是个挑战了……

description.english: The cave fairy Zelya in the Forgotten Hollow explained that she once lived much deeper inside the cave. She longs to return to her old home, but while out on a walk she was attacked by Glowshrooms and dropped the map she had drawn to find her way back. The monsters may have already torn it to pieces, but if I defeat the Glowshrooms east of Forgotten Hollow and gather the fragments, she might be able to figure something out.
description.chinese: 遗忘空洞里的洞穴妖精泽莉娅告诉我，她曾经住在洞穴更深处。她很想回到从前的家，但有一次外出散步时，她遭到发光蘑菇袭击，弄丢了自己画的返家地图。那些怪物可能已经把地图撕成碎片了，但如果我打倒遗忘空洞东边的发光蘑菇，并收集地图碎片，她也许还能想出办法。

completionText.english: As the cave fairy Zelya requested, I defeated the monsters and brought back the fragments of the map to her original home. Hopefully some clues can still be found within them...
completionText.chinese: 按照洞穴妖精泽莉娅的请求，我打倒了怪物，并把通往她旧家的地图碎片带了回来。希望里面还能找到一些线索……

summary.english: The cave fairy Zelya in the Forgotten Hollow seems to have a new request.
summary.chinese: 遗忘空洞里的洞穴妖精泽莉娅似乎有新的请求。

description.english: The cave fairy Zelya in the Forgotten Hollow was struggling to piece together the fragments of her map. To restore it, she asked me to bring her Raffle Petals, which can be obtained by defeating Raffles east of the village. Looks like that’s where I'll need to go.
description.chinese: 遗忘空洞里的洞穴妖精泽莉娅正努力把地图碎片拼回去。为了修复地图，她让我带来莱芙花瓣，这些可以通过打倒村庄东边的莱芙获得。看来我接下来得去那里了。

completionText.english: As Zelya requested, I defeated Raffles and gathered enough Raffle Petals to bring back to her.
completionText.chinese: 按照泽莉娅的请求，我打倒了莱芙，并收集了足够的莱芙花瓣带回给她。

summary.english: The cave fairy Zelya in Forgotten Hollow seems to have yet another request.
summary.chinese: 遗忘空洞里的洞穴妖精泽莉娅似乎又有新的请求。

description.english: Zelya restored her precious map and tried to follow it back to her old home, but she could not make it past the fierce monsters blocking the way. She asked me to defeat the monsters west of the Forgotten Hollow to help her get home safely.
description.chinese: 泽莉娅修好了她珍贵的地图，并试着按照地图回到从前的家，但她没能通过挡在路上的凶猛怪物。她请求我打倒遗忘空洞西边的怪物，帮助她安全回家。

completionText.english: As Zelya requested, I defeated Aqumanders and Echopuses. Yet it felt as though monsters continued to pour out from deeper within the cave. What on earth could be happening inside
completionText.chinese: 按照泽莉娅的请求，我打倒了水螈和回音章鱼。然而感觉仍有怪物不断从洞穴更深处涌出来。里面到底发生了什么？

summary.english: Myra in Perilous Descent I seems to be overcome with grief.
summary.chinese: 险峻下坡I的米拉似乎被悲伤吞没了。

description.english: Myra in Perilous Descent I wants her changed companions to rest in peace. At her request, I must put down the nearby Myewood, as well as the Sporewood deeper in the cave.
description.chinese: 险峻下坡I的米拉希望她那些已经变异的同伴能够安息。应她的请求，我必须放倒附近的木喵，以及洞穴更深处的孢子木。

completionText.english: Following Myra’s plea, I had no choice but to fell the creatures that were once her companions. How did they end up like this...
completionText.chinese: 按照米拉的请求，我别无选择，只能砍倒那些曾经是她同伴的生物。它们到底为什么会变成这样……

summary.english: Myra in Perilous Descent I seems to have another request.
summary.chinese: 险峻下坡I的米拉似乎还有另一个请求。

description.english: Myra in Perilous Descent I asked me to deliver news of this place to another of her old friends, Grendel the Really Old. I should be able to find Grendel the Really Old atop Ellinia, at the Magic Library.
description.chinese: 险峻下坡I的米拉让我把这里的消息告诉她的另一位老朋友——大魔法师汉斯。我应该可以在魔法密林顶端的魔法图书馆找到汉斯。

completionText.english: When I met Grendel the Really Old in Ellinia, he was astonished to hear that the Forgotten Hollow had been rediscovered, and he seemed deeply troubled about what was happening there.
completionText.chinese: 我在魔法密林见到汉斯后，他听说遗忘空洞被重新发现时大吃一惊，并且似乎对那里正在发生的事情感到非常担忧。

quests.english: Special Taste of Florina Beach I
quests.chinese: 黄金海岸的特别味道 I

summary.english: A beautiful girl by the name of Riel from Florina Beach seems to be in need of help...
summary.chinese: 黄金海岸有一位名叫丽尔的美丽女孩，似乎需要帮助……

description.english: Riel introduced me to a part time job, where I have to collect 10 Coconuts. Why don't I start collecting those delicious looking Coconuts over there on the right
description.chinese: 丽尔给我介绍了一份兼职工作，需要我收集10个椰子。为什么不先去右边收集那些看起来很好吃的椰子呢？

completionText.english: I brought back fresh Coconuts just like Riel said. Riel told me I can come back for work anytime I want. I guess I won't be starving here in Florina Beach.
completionText.chinese: 我按照丽尔说的，带回了新鲜的椰子。丽尔告诉我，以后随时都可以回来工作。看来我在黄金海岸不用担心挨饿了。

quests.english: Special Taste of Florina Beach II

summary.english: Riel in Florina Beach asks me a question about Florina Beach. Piece of cake~ I can answer that before I start my work.
summary.chinese: 黄金海滩的丽尔给我提了个问题. 那对我来说一点也不难.

description.english: I have to prepare enough ingredients for 15 people, and bring them to Riel in Florina Beach.

completionText.english: I answered all the questions that Riel gave me and passed her tests, then went to collect ingredients for 15 people.
completionText.chinese: 我回答了丽尔提出的所有问题.通过她的问答后，我又帮她收集了菜的材料.

quests.english: Special Taste of Florina Beach III

summary.english: It seems that Riel in Florina Beach wants to ask for another favor.
summary.chinese: 黄金海岸的丽尔似乎还想拜托我另一件事。

description.english: I have to bring ingredients for 30 people to Riel in Florina Beach.

completionText.english: I worked part-time gathering ingredients for cooked meals for the tourists coming to Florina Beach.
completionText.chinese: 在黄金海滩完成了收集菜的材料的工作.

quests.english: Special Taste of Florina Beach IV
quests.chinese: 黄金海岸的特别味道 IV

summary.english: Riel is trying to develop a special dish in Florina Beach.
summary.chinese: 丽尔正在黄金海岸研究一道特别料理。

description.english: I need to collect some ingredients to develop the Special Taste of Florina Beach. I heard that 10 Coconuts, 10 Lorang Claws, 10 Clang Claws, and 10 Lupin's Bananas are necessary. Will Valen's new recipe succeed~
description.chinese: 我需要收集一些食材来开发黄金海岸的特别味道。听说需要10个椰子、10个洛朗的爪子、10个克朗的爪子和10根猴子的香蕉。瓦伦的新食谱会成功吗～

completionText.english: I'm familiar with working in Florina Beach. I visited Riel one more time and helped her out. Why is she so desperate to help Valen
completionText.chinese: 我已经很熟悉在黄金海岸打工了。我又去拜访了丽尔，并帮了她的忙。她为什么这么拼命地想帮助瓦伦呢？

summary.english: Having reached level 30 and mastered the way of the Swordsman, I feel the urge to learn even more.
summary.chinese: 达到30级并掌握剑士之道后，我开始渴望学习更多东西。

description.english: Perhaps Dances with Balrog of Perion could teach me greater lessons.
description.chinese: 也许勇士部落的与炎魔共舞能够教我更深层的课程。

completionText.english: Perion’s Dances with Balrog seemed surprised to see how much stronger I had become compared to before.
completionText.chinese: 勇士部落的与炎魔共舞看到我比以前强了这么多，似乎感到很惊讶。

summary.english: It seemed like Dances with Balrog in Perion wanted to test whether I was worthy of receiving his teachings.
summary.chinese: 勇士部落的与炎魔共舞似乎想测试我是否有资格接受他的教导。

description.english: Perion’s Dances with Balrog handed me a letter and told me to deliver it to Warrior Job Instructor, who can be found somewhere in West Rocky Mountain IV. He said I’d be able to learn more details there.
description.chinese: 勇士部落的与炎魔共舞交给我一封信，让我把它送给战士转职教官。那位教官可以在西部岩山IV的某个地方找到。他说我到那里后就能知道更多详情。

completionText.english: In West Rocky Mountain IV, I met Warrior Job Instructor. He said he would test whether I was worthy of making the 2nd job advancement. Great! I told him I was ready for anything!
completionText.chinese: 我在西部岩山IV遇见了战士转职教官。他说他会测试我是否有资格进行第二次转职。太好了！我告诉他，我已经准备好面对任何挑战了！

summary.english: West Rocky Mountain IV’s Warrior Job Instructor seems ready to give me a test to prove whether I deserve to become stronger.
summary.chinese: 西部岩山IV的战士转职教官似乎准备给我一场测试，证明我是否有资格变得更强。

description.english: West Rocky Mountain IV’s Warrior Job Instructor gave me a mission to enter a hidden area, defeat the monsters there, and collect a certain item.
description.chinese: 西部岩山IV的战士转职教官给了我一个任务：进入隐藏区域，打败里面的怪物，并收集某个物品。

completionText.english: I passed Warrior Job Instructor’s test in West Rocky Mountain IV!
completionText.chinese: 我通过了西部岩山IV战士转职教官的测试！

summary.english: Now that I’ve passed Warrior Job Instructor’s test, my strength should be proven!
summary.chinese: 既然我已经通过了战士转职教官的测试，我的实力应该已经得到证明了！

description.english: I received The Proof of a Hero for successfully passing the Warrior Job Instructor’s test. I should return to Dances with Balrog in Perion.
description.chinese: 我成功通过了战士转职教官的测试，并收到了英雄的证明。现在我应该回勇士部落找与炎魔共舞。

completionText.english: Dances with Balrog in Perion welcomed me warmly, and I gained a new job, obtaining even greater power!
completionText.chinese: 勇士部落的与炎魔共舞热情地欢迎了我，而我也获得了新的职业，得到了更强大的力量！

summary.english: Having reached level 30 and mastered the way of the Magician, I feel the urge to learn even more.
summary.chinese: 达到30级并掌握魔法师之道后，我开始渴望学习更多东西。

description.english: Perhaps Grendel the Really Old of Ellinia could teach me greater lessons.
description.chinese: 也许魔法密林的大魔法师汉斯能够教我更深层的课程。

completionText.english: Grendel the Really Old said that if I can pass the test he gives, he’ll gladly teach me more. I’m no longer the weakling I once was, but hearing that I still have to face a trial makes me a bit nervous.

summary.english: Look for Arwen the Fairy in Ellinia. It seems she has a favor to ask me.
summary.chinese: 去魔法密林找妖精艾温。她似乎有事想拜托我。

description.english: Let's take the Strange Mushroom Spore Strange Mushroom Spore given by Arwen the Fairy to Grendel the Really Old for analysis. Then talk to Arwen the Fairy again.
description.chinese: 把妖精艾温给我的奇怪蘑菇孢子带给大魔法师汉斯分析吧。之后再和妖精艾温对话。

completionText.english: I informed Arwen the Fairy about the results of Grendel the Really Old's analysis on the Strange Mushroom Spore Strange Mushroom Spore.

summary.english: Arwen the Fairy in Ellinia wants to speak with me again about the Strange Mushroom Spore Strange Mushroom Spore found last time.
summary.chinese: 魔法密林的妖精艾温想再次和我谈谈上次发现的奇怪蘑菇孢子。

description.english: As requested by Arwen the Fairy, let's head to The Tree Tunnel At the Forest Up North to find the strange cave entrance and investigate the surroundings.
description.chinese: 按照妖精艾温的请求，前往北部森林树洞，寻找奇怪的洞穴入口，并调查周围情况吧。

completionText.english: I delivered the Glowing Mushroom Glowing Mushroom found at the cave entrance to Arwen the Fairy.
completionText.chinese: 我把在洞穴入口发现的发光蘑菇交给了妖精艾温。

quests.english: [Event] The One Who Sealed the Darkness

summary.english: Grendel the Really Old has something to say about the newly discovered bizarre cave entrance...
summary.chinese: 大魔法师汉斯对新发现的怪异洞穴入口似乎有话要说……

description.english: Grendel the Really Old is worried that there might be a problem with the World Tree and told me to go ask Manji in Perion.
description.chinese: 大魔法师汉斯担心世界树可能出了问题，让我去勇士部落询问曼吉。

completionText.english: I couldn't get any answers from Manji... but I was able to see the battle he fought beneath the World Tree.
completionText.chinese: 我没能从曼吉那里得到答案……但我看见了他曾在世界树下进行的那场战斗。

summary.english: The Maple Administrator in Henesys has something to say regarding the mysterious letters dropping from monsters lately.
summary.chinese: 射手村的冒险岛运营员似乎想谈谈最近从怪物身上掉落的神秘字母。

description.english: I need to collect the mysterious letters dropped by monsters Lv. 10 and above such as Ribbon Pig, Dark Stump, Octopus and Green Mushroom.. Maple Administrator in Henesys will exchange them for a helpful gift for my adventure...
description.chinese: 我需要收集10级以上怪物掉落的神秘字母，例如蝴蝶猪、黑木妖、章鱼和绿蘑菇等。射手村的冒险岛运营员会用它们交换一份对冒险有帮助的礼物……

completionText.english: I collected all the mysterious letters and exchanged them for a gift today. Let's visit Maple Administrator in Henesys again tomorrow.
completionText.chinese: 我今天收集齐了所有神秘字母，并兑换了礼物。明天再去射手村找冒险岛运营员吧。

summary.english: There is a gift prepared for those setting off on a new adventure in Classic World...
summary.chinese: 为踏上经典世界新冒险的人准备了一份礼物……

description.english: There is a gift prepared for those setting off on a new adventure in Classic World...
description.chinese: 为踏上经典世界新冒险的人准备了一份礼物……

completionText.chinese: 我领取了为踏上经典世界新冒险的人准备的礼物。

quests.english: "Mar" the Fairy and the Water of Life

summary.chinese: 去找妖精“玛尔”。

description.chinese: 妖精“玛尔”似乎和生命之水有关。

completionText.chinese: 完成了妖精“玛尔”和生命之水相关的请求。

summary.english: It seems that Casey in Henesys Park knows a way to find a different kind of fun in Maple World.
summary.chinese: 射手村公园的凯西似乎知道一种能在冒险岛世界里体验不同乐趣的方法。

description.english: Casey, whom I met in Henesys Park, said he knows a way to enjoy myself when I get tired of hunting, and asked me to collect Monster Cards. He said I could easily get them by defeating any of these monsters scattered across Maple World: Blue Snail, Pig, Ribbon Pig, Octopus, Blue Mushroom, Horny Mushroom, Evil Eye, Curse Eye, Lupin, Cold Eye, Lorang, Tortie, Wraith, Drake, Wild Kargo. I should try to gather them when I have the time.
description.chinese: 我在射手村公园遇见的凯西说，当我厌倦狩猎时，他知道一种能让我放松娱乐的方法，并让我收集怪物卡。他说只要打倒分布在冒险岛世界各地的这些怪物，就能比较容易地获得：蓝蜗牛、猪、蝴蝶猪、章鱼、蓝蘑菇、刺蘑菇、风独眼兽、诅咒独眼兽、猴子、冰独眼兽、洛朗、乌龟、幽灵、幼龙、野生卡戈。有时间的话，我应该试着收集它们。

completionText.english: I brought the requested items to Casey in Henesys Park and received a Set of Match Cards! With this, I can play the Match Cards mini-game with other adventurers anywhere! I should remember to ask Casey if I want to know more about the mini-game.
completionText.chinese: 我把凯西要求的物品带到了射手村公园，并收到了记忆卡套组！有了这个，我就能随时随地和其他冒险家一起玩记忆卡小游戏了！如果我想了解更多关于小游戏的事情，应该记得去问凯西。

quests.english: Silas Irons in Need of an Apprentice
quests.chinese: 西拉斯·艾恩斯需要学徒

summary.english: The master blacksmith of Perion, Silas Irons, seems to be looking for someone worthy of becoming his apprentice.
summary.chinese: 勇士部落的铁匠大师西拉斯·艾恩斯似乎正在寻找有资格成为他学徒的人。

description.english: The master blacksmith of Perion, Silas Irons, has given me a test to see if I’m fit to become his apprentice. He says a blacksmith needs proper strength and knowledge, and told me to defeat monsters around Perion and bring back raw ore. It looks like raw ore can be obtained from monsters.
description.chinese: 勇士部落的铁匠大师西拉斯·艾恩斯给了我一个测试，想看看我是否适合成为他的学徒。他说铁匠需要足够的力量和知识，并让我打倒勇士部落周围的怪物，带回原矿。看起来原矿可以从怪物身上获得。

completionText.english: I passed the test given by Silas Irons, the master blacksmith of Perion. Does this mean I can become a true blacksmith in Maple World
completionText.chinese: 我通过了勇士部落铁匠大师西拉斯·艾恩斯给出的测试。这是不是意味着我能成为冒险岛世界里真正的铁匠了？

quests.english: A Blacksmith in My Own Right!
quests.chinese: 我也是独当一面的铁匠了！

summary.english: It looks like Silas Irons, the master blacksmith of Perion, is finally ready to acknowledge my skills.
summary.chinese: 看来勇士部落的铁匠大师西拉斯·艾恩斯终于准备认可我的能力了。

description.english: Silas Irons, the master blacksmith of Perion, was impressed by how much I’ve grown and suggested I show off my abilities. I need to defeat Dark Axe Stumps and Zombie Mushrooms, then create an Orihalcon Ingot and a Gold Ingot, and bring them back to him.
description.chinese: 勇士部落的铁匠大师西拉斯·艾恩斯对我的成长感到印象深刻，并建议我展示自己的能力。我需要打倒黑斧木妖和僵尸蘑菇，然后制作一个奥利哈钢锭和一个金锭，并把它们带回给他。

completionText.english: Silas Irons, the master craftsman of Perion, was amazed by my work and handed me a Equipment Crafting Stimulator. It seems to be a special item that can alter the stats of equipment when used during crafting. Maybe I should give it a try.
completionText.chinese: 勇士部落的工匠大师西拉斯·艾恩斯对我的成果感到惊讶，并交给我一个装备制作促进剂。它似乎是一种特殊道具，在制作装备时使用，可以改变装备的属性。也许我应该试试看。

quests.english: Silas Irons in Need of Help
quests.chinese: 西拉斯·艾恩斯需要帮助

summary.english: It looks like Silas Irons, the master blacksmith of Perion, needs some help. Maybe I should go check in on him.
summary.chinese: 看来勇士部落的铁匠大师西拉斯·艾恩斯需要一些帮助。也许我应该去看看他。

description.english: Silas Irons, the master blacksmith of Perion, received an important request but is struggling because he’s short on materials. To help him, I need to defeat Bubblings and bring back Mithril Ingot.
description.chinese: 勇士部落的铁匠大师西拉斯·艾恩斯接到了一项重要委托，但因为材料不足而陷入困境。为了帮助他，我需要打倒大幽灵，并带回秘银锭。

completionText.english: I delivered the items Silas Irons requested without any issues. At this rate, I might really be considered a fine apprentice.
completionText.chinese: 我顺利交付了西拉斯·艾恩斯要求的物品。照这样下去，我也许真的会被当成一名优秀的学徒。

quests.english: Mr. Thunder in Need of an Apprentice

summary.english: It seems Mr. Thunder, the master weapon craftsman of Perion, is looking for someone worthy of becoming his apprentice.
summary.chinese: 勇士部落的武器制作大师雷先生似乎正在寻找有资格成为他学徒的人。

description.english: Mr. Thunder, the master weapon craftsman of Perion, gave me a test when I asked to become his apprentice. He said that weaponcrafting requires proper strength and knowledge, and told me to use my Smithing skill to craft one Bronze Ingot and one Iron Ingot. As long as I have the materials, it shouldn’t be too difficult.
description.chinese: 当我请求成为他的学徒时，勇士部落的武器制作大师雷先生给了我一个测试。他说武器制作需要足够的力量和知识，并让我使用锻造技能制作一个青铜锭和一个铁锭。只要有材料，应该不会太难。

completionText.english: I passed the test given by Mr. Thunder, the master weapon craftsman of Perion. Does this mean I can now become a true weaponcrafting specialist in Maple World
completionText.chinese: 我通过了勇士部落武器制作大师雷先生给出的测试。这是不是意味着我现在能成为冒险岛世界里真正的武器制作专家了？

quests.english: A Weaponcrafter in My Own Right!
quests.chinese: 我也是独当一面的武器匠了！

summary.english: It seems Mr. Thunder, the master weaponcrafter of Perion, is finally ready to acknowledge my weaponcrafting skills.
summary.chinese: 看来勇士部落的武器制作大师雷先生终于准备认可我的武器制作能力了。

description.english: Mr. Thunder, the master weaponcrafter of Perion, was amazed by my growth and suggested that I show off my skills. I need to defeat Iron Hogs and craft one Monkey Wrench to bring back to him.
description.chinese: 勇士部落的武器制作大师雷先生对我的成长感到惊讶，并建议我展示自己的技术。我需要打倒钢铁猪，并制作一把猴子扳手带回给他。

completionText.english: Mr. Thunder, the master weaponcrafter of Perion, was impressed by my craftsmanship and handed me a Equipment Crafting Stimulator. It looks like a special item that can change an equipment’s stats when used during crafting. Maybe I should try it out.
completionText.chinese: 勇士部落的武器制作大师雷先生对我的手艺感到满意，并交给我一个装备制作促进剂。它看起来是一种特殊道具，在制作装备时使用，可以改变装备的属性。也许我应该试试看。

quests.english: Mr. Thunder in Need of Help

summary.english: It looks like Mr. Thunder, the master weaponcrafter of Perion, could use some help. Maybe I should go check in on him.
summary.chinese: 看来勇士部落的武器制作大师雷先生需要一些帮助。也许我应该去看看他。

description.english: Mr. Thunder, the master weaponcrafter of Perion, received an important request but is having trouble because he’s short on materials. To help him, I’ll need to defeat some Axe Stumps and craft 10 Screws.
description.chinese: 勇士部落的武器制作大师雷先生接到了一项重要委托，但因为材料不足而遇到了麻烦。为了帮助他，我需要打倒一些斧木妖，并制作10个螺丝。

completionText.english: I was able to deliver the item Mr. Thunder asked for without any issues. At this rate, I might really be considered a fine apprentice.
completionText.chinese: 我顺利交付了雷先生要求的物品。照这样下去，我也许真的会被当成一名优秀的学徒。

quests.english: Francois in Need of an Apprentice

summary.english: It seems Francois, the tailor of Ellinia, is looking for someone worthy of becoming his apprentice.
summary.chinese: 魔法密林的裁缝弗朗索瓦似乎正在寻找有资格成为他学徒的人。

description.english: When I told Francois, the tailor of Ellinia, that I wanted to become his apprentice, he gave me a test. He said tailoring requires the right balance of skill and knowledge, and asked me to defeat monsters near Henesys and collect Leafs.
description.chinese: 当我告诉魔法密林的裁缝弗朗索瓦，我想成为他的学徒时，他给了我一个测试。他说裁缝需要技能与知识之间的平衡，并让我去打倒射手村附近的怪物，收集叶子。

completionText.english: I passed the test given by Francois, the tailor of Ellinia. Does this mean I can now become a proper tailor in Maple World
completionText.chinese: 我通过了魔法密林裁缝弗朗索瓦给出的测试。这是不是意味着我现在能成为冒险岛世界里真正的裁缝了？

quests.english: A Tailor in My Own Right!
quests.chinese: 我也是独当一面的裁缝了！

summary.english: It seems Francois, the tailor of Ellinia, is finally ready to acknowledge my tailoring skills.
summary.chinese: 看来魔法密林的裁缝弗朗索瓦终于准备认可我的裁缝技术了。

description.english: Francois, the tailor of Ellinia, was impressed by how much I’ve grown and suggested I show off my abilities. I need to defeat Wild Boars and craft a Red Starry Bandana to bring back.
description.chinese: 魔法密林的裁缝弗朗索瓦对我的成长感到印象深刻，并建议我展示自己的能力。我需要打倒野猪，并制作一条红色星星头巾带回来。

completionText.english: Francois, the tailor of Ellinia, admired my craftsmanship and handed me a Equipment Crafting Stimulator. It seems to be a special item that can alter an equipment’s stats when used during crafting. Maybe I should give it a try.
completionText.chinese: 魔法密林的裁缝弗朗索瓦欣赏我的手艺，并交给我一个装备制作促进剂。它似乎是一种特殊道具，在制作装备时使用，可以改变装备的属性。也许我应该试试看。

summary.english: It looks like Francois, the tailor of Ellinia, could use some help. Maybe I should stop by after a while.
summary.chinese: 看来魔法密林的裁缝弗朗索瓦需要一些帮助。也许我过一阵子应该去看看他。

description.english: Francois, the tailor of Ellinia, received an important request but is struggling due to a lack of materials. To help him out, I need to defeat Green Mushrooms and craft 10 Spool of Thread to bring back.
description.chinese: 魔法密林的裁缝弗朗索瓦接到了一项重要委托，但因为缺少材料而陷入困境。为了帮助他，我需要打倒绿蘑菇，并制作10个线轴带回来。

completionText.english: I was able to safely deliver the item Francois asked for. At this point, I’d say I’ve proven myself to be a pretty solid apprentice.
completionText.chinese: 我顺利交付了弗朗索瓦要求的物品。到这个程度，我觉得自己已经证明了我是个相当可靠的学徒。

summary.english: It seems Vicious, the carpenter of Henesys, is looking for someone worthy of becoming his apprentice.
summary.chinese: 射手村的木匠维西似乎正在寻找有资格成为他学徒的人。

completionText.english: I passed the test given by Vicious, the carpenter of Henesys. Does this mean I can now become a proper carpenter in Maple World
completionText.chinese: 我通过了射手村木匠维西给出的测试。这是不是意味着我现在能成为冒险岛世界里真正的木匠了？

quests.english: A Carpenter in My Own Right!
quests.chinese: 我也是独当一面的木匠了！

summary.english: It seems Vicious, the carpenter of Henesys, is finally ready to acknowledge my woodworking skills.
summary.chinese: 看来射手村的木匠维西终于准备认可我的木工技术了。

description.english: Vicious, the carpenter of Henesys, was impressed by how much I’ve grown and suggested I show off my abilities. I need to defeat Dark Axe Stumps and craft The Red Relaxer to bring back.
description.chinese: 射手村的木匠维西对我的成长感到印象深刻，并建议我展示自己的能力。我需要打倒黑斧木妖，并制作红色休闲椅带回来。

completionText.english: Vicious, the carpenter of Henesys, admired my craftsmanship and handed me a Equipment Crafting Stimulator. It seems to be a special item that can alter an equipment’s stats when used during crafting. Maybe I should give it a try.
completionText.chinese: 射手村的木匠维西欣赏我的手艺，并交给我一个装备制作促进剂。它似乎是一种特殊道具，在制作装备时使用，可以改变装备的属性。也许我应该试试看。

summary.english: It looks like Vicious, the carpenter of Henesys, could use some help. Maybe I should pay him a visit after a while.
summary.chinese: 看来射手村的木匠维西需要一些帮助。也许我过一阵子应该去拜访他。

description.english: Vicious, the carpenter of Henesys, received an important request but is struggling due to a lack of materials. To help him out, I need to defeat Axe Stumps and craft one Processed Wood.
description.chinese: 射手村的木匠维西接到了一项重要委托，但因为缺少材料而陷入困境。为了帮助他，我需要打倒斧木妖，并制作一个加工木材。

completionText.english: I was able to safely deliver the item Vicious asked for. At this point, I’d say I’ve proven myself to be a worthy apprentice.
completionText.chinese: 我顺利交付了维西要求的物品。到这个程度，我觉得自己已经证明了我是个合格的学徒。

quests.english: JM From tha Streetz Looking for a Partner

summary.english: The leatherworking master JM From tha Streetz of Kerning City seems to be looking for someone who could become a business partner.
summary.chinese: 废弃都市的皮革制作大师街头的JM似乎正在寻找可以成为商业伙伴的人。

description.english: The leatherworking master JM From tha Streetz of Kerning City gave me a test to see if I’m worthy of becoming a partner. He said that proper strength and knowledge are required for leatherworking, and asked me to defeat monsters around Kerning City and Henesys to collect Leather.
description.chinese: 废弃都市的皮革制作大师街头的JM给了我一个测试，想看看我是否有资格成为他的伙伴。他说皮革制作需要足够的力量和知识，并让我打倒废弃都市和射手村周围的怪物，收集皮革。

completionText.english: I passed the test given by the leatherworking master JM From tha Streetz of Kerning City. Could this mean that I, too, can stand proudly as a leatherworker in the Maple World
completionText.chinese: 我通过了废弃都市皮革制作大师街头的JM给出的测试。这是不是意味着我也能在冒险岛世界里堂堂正正地成为一名皮革工匠了？

quests.english: A Leatherworker in My Own Right!
quests.chinese: 我也是独当一面的皮革工匠了！

summary.english: It seems the leatherworking master JM From tha Streetz of Kerning City is finally ready to acknowledge my leatherworking skills.
summary.chinese: 看来废弃都市的皮革制作大师街头的JM终于准备认可我的皮革制作能力了。

description.english: Impressed by my growth, the leatherworking master JM From tha Streetz of Kerning City suggested that I show what I’m capable of. I must defeat Wild Boars and craft 1 Red Chair, then bring it back.
description.chinese: 废弃都市的皮革制作大师街头的JM对我的成长感到印象深刻，并建议我展示自己的本事。我必须打倒野猪，并制作1张红色椅子，然后带回去。

completionText.english: Amazed by my craftsmanship, the leatherworking master JM From tha Streetz of Kerning City handed me a Equipment Crafting Stimulator. It seems to be a special item that can alter equipment stats when used during crafting. Should I try using it
completionText.chinese: 废弃都市的皮革制作大师街头的JM对我的手艺感到惊讶，并交给我一个装备制作促进剂。它似乎是一种特殊道具，在制作装备时使用，可以改变装备的属性。我要不要试试看呢？

quests.english: JM From tha Streetz in Need of Help

summary.english: It looks like the leatherworking master JM From tha Streetz of Kerning City needs help again. It's been a while, perhaps I should pay him a visit.
summary.chinese: 看来废弃都市的皮革制作大师街头的JM又需要帮助了。已经有一阵子没见了，也许我应该去拜访他。

description.english: The leatherworking master JM From tha Streetz of Kerning City has received an important request but is struggling due to a lack of materials. To help him, I’ll need to defeat Jr. Neckis and gather Jr. Necki Skins.
description.chinese: 废弃都市的皮革制作大师街头的JM接到了一项重要委托，但因为缺少材料而陷入困境。为了帮助他，我需要打倒小青蛇，并收集小青蛇皮。

completionText.english: I was able to safely deliver the items requested by the leatherworking master JM From tha Streetz of Kerning City. At this point, wouldn’t I qualify as a reliable partner
completionText.chinese: 我顺利交付了废弃都市皮革制作大师街头的JM要求的物品。到这个程度，我是不是已经算得上可靠的伙伴了？

quests.english: Chrishrama in Need of an Apprentice

summary.english: The Arcforger master Chrishrama of Sleepywood seems to be searching for someone who could become his apprentice.
summary.chinese: 林中之城的秘法锻造大师克里斯拉玛似乎正在寻找可以成为他学徒的人。

description.english: The Arcforger master Chrishrama of Sleepywood gave me a test when I asked to become his apprentice. He said true Arcforgers must possess great wisdom, and instructed me to defeat monsters around Sleepywood and gather a Garnet Ore.
description.chinese: 当我请求成为他的学徒时，林中之城的秘法锻造大师克里斯拉玛给了我一个测试。他说真正的秘法锻造师必须拥有强大的智慧，并指示我打倒林中之城周围的怪物，收集一块石榴石原石。

completionText.english: I passed the test given by the Arcforger master Chrishrama of Sleepywood. Does this mean I can finally stand as a true Arcforger in Maple World
completionText.chinese: 我通过了林中之城秘法锻造大师克里斯拉玛给出的测试。这是不是意味着我终于能以真正的秘法锻造师身份立足于冒险岛世界了？

quests.english: An Arcforger in My Own Right!
quests.chinese: 我也是独当一面的秘法锻造师了！

summary.english: It seems the Arcforger master Chrishrama of Sleepywood is finally ready to recognize my Arcforging skills.
summary.chinese: 看来林中之城的秘法锻造大师克里斯拉玛终于准备认可我的秘法锻造能力了。

description.english: The Arcforger master Chrishrama of Sleepywood was impressed with my growth and challenged me to prove my skill. I must defeat Horny Mushrooms and craft 1 Topaz to bring back.
description.chinese: 林中之城的秘法锻造大师克里斯拉玛对我的成长感到印象深刻，并挑战我证明自己的技术。我必须打倒刺蘑菇，并制作1颗黄晶带回来。

completionText.english: Amazed by my craftsmanship, the Arcforger master Chrishrama of Sleepywood handed me a Scroll Crafting Stimulator. It appears to be a special item that can create even stronger scrolls when used during crafting. Should I give it a try
completionText.chinese: 林中之城的秘法锻造大师克里斯拉玛对我的手艺感到惊讶，并交给我一个卷轴制作促进剂。它似乎是一种特殊道具，在制作卷轴时使用，可以创造出更强大的卷轴。我要不要试试看呢？

summary.english: The Arcforger master Chrishrama of Sleepywood seems to need help. Perhaps I should visit him again.
summary.chinese: 林中之城的秘法锻造大师克里斯拉玛似乎需要帮助。也许我应该再去拜访他。

description.english: The Arcforger master Chrishrama of Sleepywood has received an important research request, but he is struggling due to a lack of materials. To help him, I’ll need to defeat Green Mushrooms and gather 10 Fragment of Magic.
description.chinese: 林中之城的秘法锻造大师克里斯拉玛接到了一项重要研究委托，但因为缺少材料而陷入困境。为了帮助他，我需要打倒绿蘑菇，并收集10个魔法碎片。

completionText.english: I was able to safely deliver the item requested by the Arcforger master Chrishrama of Sleepywood. Does this mean I can now be called his apprentice
completionText.chinese: 我顺利交付了林中之城秘法锻造大师克里斯拉玛要求的物品。这是不是意味着我现在可以被称为他的学徒了？

changes: Used translations (3).json as the base file and preserved its expanded bilingual sections.
Merged corrected items, quest names, quest texts, and existing NPC seed translations from translations_updated_full.json.
Filled previously blank bilingual skills, quests, NPCs, and monsters with Chinese translations.
Added id-keyed translations.npcs and translations.monsters sections for direct lookup.
Normalized recurring terms such as 秘银, 精金, 奥利哈钢, 寂静, 凉鞋, and 英雄的证明.
Fixed verified item-name ID mismatches in consumables, chairs, etc drops, quest items, craft materials, Omok pieces, and the Dark Moonlight equipment color issue.
Synchronized corrected Chinese names between translations.items/translations.monsters and bilingual.items/bilingual.monsters.
Applied a second pass for equipment entries where the English color/prefix clearly contradicted the Chinese color/name.

fixed: Filled bilingual quest text chinese fields from translations.questTexts.
Manually translated remaining non-empty English quest text fields.
Added neutral Chinese placeholders only where the English source text was empty.
Synchronized IDs and Chinese names across translations maps and bilingual arrays.
